verses.original: וּפְלִשְׁתִּים֙ לָֽקְח֔וּ אֵ֖ת אֲר֣וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיְבִאֻ֛הוּ מֵאֶ֥בֶן הָעֵ֖זֶר אַשְׁדּֽוֹדָה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ə·liš·tîm lā·qə·ḥū ’êṯ ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm way·ḇi·’u·hū mê·’e·ḇen hā·‘ê·zer ’aš·dō·w·ḏāh
verses.literal: After the Philistines had captured the ark of God they took it from Ebenezer to Ashdod
verses.literalPt: Os filisteus tomaram a arca de Deus e a trouxeram de Ebenézer até Asdode.

verses.original: וַיִּקְח֤וּ פְלִשְׁתִּים֙ אֶת־ אֲר֣וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיָּבִ֥יאוּ אֹת֖וֹ בֵּ֣ית דָּג֑וֹן וַיַּצִּ֥יגוּ אֹת֖וֹ אֵ֥צֶל דָּגֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·ḥū p̄ə·liš·tîm ’eṯ- ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yā·ḇî·’ū ’ō·ṯōw bêṯ dā·ḡō·wn way·yaṣ·ṣî·ḡū ’ō·ṯōw ’ê·ṣel dā·ḡō·wn
verses.literal: - . . . carried it into the temple of Dagon and set it beside his statue
verses.literalPt: Tomando-a, meteram-na no templo de Dagom e colocaram-na junto a Dagom.

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁכִּ֤מוּ אַשְׁדּוֹדִים֙ מִֽמָּחֳרָ֔ת וְהִנֵּ֣ה דָג֗וֹן נֹפֵ֤ל לְפָנָיו֙ אַ֔רְצָה לִפְנֵ֖י אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּקְחוּ֙ אֶת־ דָּג֔וֹן וַיָּשִׁ֥בוּ אֹת֖וֹ לִמְקוֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaš·ki·mū ’aš·dō·w·ḏîm mim·mā·ḥo·rāṯ wə·hin·nêh ḏā·ḡō·wn nō·p̄êl lə·p̄ā·nāw ’ar·ṣāh lip̄·nê ’ă·rō·wn Yah·weh way·yiq·ḥū ’eṯ- dā·ḡō·wn way·yā·ši·ḇū ’ō·ṯōw lim·qō·w·mōw
verses.literal: When the people of Ashdod got up early the next morning there was Dagon fallen on his face . . . before the ark of the LORD So they took Dagon and returned him to his place
verses.literalPt: Tendo-se levantado de madrugada no dia seguinte os de Asdode, eis que estava Dagom caído com o rosto em terra, diante da arca de Jeová. Tomaram a Dagom e tornaram a pô-lo no seu lugar.

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁכִּ֣מוּ בַבֹּקֶר֮ מִֽמָּחֳרָת֒ וְהִנֵּ֣ה דָג֗וֹן נֹפֵ֤ל לְפָנָיו֙ אַ֔רְצָה לִפְנֵ֖י אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֑ה וְרֹ֨אשׁ דָּג֜וֹן וּשְׁתֵּ֣י׀ כַּפּ֣וֹת יָדָ֗יו כְּרֻתוֹת֙ אֶל־ הַמִּפְתָּ֔ן רַ֥ק דָּג֖וֹן נִשְׁאַ֥ר עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaš·ki·mū ḇab·bō·qer mim·mā·ḥo·rāṯ wə·hin·nêh ḏā·ḡō·wn nō·p̄êl lə·p̄ā·nāw ’ar·ṣāh lip̄·nê ’ă·rō·wn Yah·weh wə·rōš dā·ḡō·wn ū·šə·tê kap·pō·wṯ yā·ḏāw kə·ru·ṯō·wṯ ’el- ham·mip̄·tān raq dā·ḡō·wn niš·’ar ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: But when they got up early the next morning there was Dagon fallen on his face . . . before the ark of the LORD with his head . . . and his hands broken off and lying on the threshold Only the torso remained . . .
verses.literalPt: Levantando-se de manhã, no dia seguinte, eis que estava Dagom caído com o rosto em terra, diante da arca de Jeová; e a cabeça de Dagom e ambas as palmas das suas mãos estavam cortadas sobre o limiar, somente havendo-lhe ficado o tronco.

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֡ן לֹֽא־ יִדְרְכוּ֩ כֹהֲנֵ֨י דָג֜וֹן וְכָֽל־ הַבָּאִ֧ים בֵּית־ דָּג֛וֹן עַל־ מִפְתַּ֥ן דָּג֖וֹן בְּאַשְׁדּ֑וֹד עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên lō- yiḏ·rə·ḵū ḵō·hă·nê ḏā·ḡō·wn wə·ḵāl hab·bā·’îm bêṯ- dā·ḡō·wn ‘al- mip̄·tan dā·ḡō·wn bə·’aš·dō·wḏ ‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: That is why . . . to this day the priests of Dagon and all who enter the temple of Dagon in Ashdod do not step on the threshold . . .
verses.literalPt: Por isso, os sacerdotes de Dagom e todos os que entram no seu templo não pisam o limiar de Dagom em Asdode, até o dia de hoje.

verses.original: וַתִּכְבַּ֧ד יַד־ יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־ הָאַשְׁדּוֹדִ֖ים וַיְשִׁמֵּ֑ם וַיַּ֤ךְ אֹתָם֙ בָּעֳפָלִים אֶת־ אַשְׁדּ֖וֹד וְאֶת־ גְּבוּלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiḵ·baḏ yaḏ- Yah·weh ’el- hā·’aš·dō·w·ḏîm way·šim·mêm way·yaḵ ’ō·ṯām bå̄·ʿo·p̄å̄·līm ’eṯ- ’aš·dō·wḏ wə·’eṯ- gə·ḇū·le·hā
verses.literal: Now the hand of the LORD was heavy on the people of Ashdod and its vicinity ravaging them and afflicting them with tumors
verses.literalPt: Mas a mão de Jeová pesou sobre os de Asdode, e os assolou, e os feriu de tumores, a saber, a Asdode e aos seus termos.

verses.original: וַיִּרְא֥וּ אַנְשֵֽׁי־ אַשְׁדּ֖וֹד כִּֽי־ כֵ֑ן וְאָמְר֗וּ לֹֽא־ יֵשֵׁ֞ב אֲר֨וֹן אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ עִמָּ֔נוּ כִּֽי־ קָשְׁתָ֤ה יָדוֹ֙ עָלֵ֔ינוּ וְעַ֖ל דָּג֥וֹן אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·’ū ’an·šê- ’aš·dō·wḏ kî- ḵên wə·’ā·mə·rū lō- yê·šêḇ ’ă·rō·wn ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ‘im·mā·nū kî- qā·šə·ṯāh yā·ḏōw ‘ā·lê·nū wə·‘al dā·ḡō·wn ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū
verses.literal: And when the men of Ashdod saw what was happening . . . they said The ark of the God of Israel must not stay here with us because His hand is heavy upon us and upon our god Dagon
verses.literalPt: O que tendo visto os homens de Asdode, disseram: Não fique conosco a arca do Deus de Israel, porque a sua mão descarrega duramente sobre nós e sobre Dagom, nosso deus.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלְח֡וּ וַיַּאַסְפוּ֩ אֶת־ כָּל־ סַרְנֵ֨י פְלִשְׁתִּ֜ים אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ מַֽה־ נַּעֲשֶׂ֗ה לַֽאֲרוֹן֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ גַּ֣ת יִסֹּ֔ב אֲר֖וֹן אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיַּסֵּ֕בּוּ אֶת־ אֲר֖וֹן אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·lə·ḥū way·ya·’as·p̄ū ’eṯ- kāl- sar·nê p̄ə·liš·tîm ’ă·lê·hem way·yō·mə·rū mah- na·‘ă·śeh la·’ă·rō·wn ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mə·rū gaṯ yis·sōḇ ’ă·rō·wn ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl way·yas·sêb·bū ’eṯ- ’ă·rō·wn ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: So they called together all . . . the rulers of the Philistines and asked What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel It . . . . . . must be moved to Gath they replied So they carried away the ark of the God of Israel
verses.literalPt: Enviaram, e congregaram a si todos os régulos dos filisteus, e perguntaram: Que faremos nós da arca do Deus de Israel? Responderam eles: Seja levada a arca do Deus de Israel até Gate. Foi levada a arca do Deus de Israel até lá.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י אַחֲרֵ֣י׀ הֵסַ֣בּוּ אֹת֗וֹ וַתְּהִ֨י יַד־ יְהוָ֤ה׀ בָּעִיר֙ מְהוּמָה֙ גְּדוֹלָ֣ה מְאֹ֔ד וַיַּךְ֙ אֶת־ אַנְשֵׁ֣י הָעִ֔יר מִקָּטֹ֖ן וְעַד־ גָּד֑וֹל וַיִּשָּׂתְר֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם עֳפָלִים׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’a·ḥă·rê hê·sab·bū ’ō·ṯōw wat·tə·hî yaḏ- Yah·weh bā·‘îr mə·hū·māh gə·ḏō·w·lāh mə·’ōḏ way·yaḵ ’eṯ- ’an·šê hā·‘îr miq·qā·ṭōn wə·‘aḏ- gā·ḏō·wl way·yiś·śā·ṯə·rū lā·hem ʿo·p̄å̄·līm
verses.literal: But after they had moved the ark to Gath . . . the LORD’s hand was also against that city throwing it into great confusion . . . . . . and afflicting the men of the city both young and old with an outbreak . . . of tumors
verses.literalPt: Depois de a terem levado para lá, foi a mão de Jeová contra a cidade num grande vexame; feriu aos homens, tanto pequenos como grandes, e nasceram-lhes tumores.

verses.original: וַֽיְשַׁלְּח֛וּ אֶת־ אֲר֥וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים עֶקְר֑וֹן וַיְהִ֗י כְּב֨וֹא אֲר֤וֹן הָאֱלֹהִים֙ עֶקְר֔וֹן וַיִּזְעֲק֨וּ הָֽעֶקְרֹנִ֜ים לֵאמֹ֗ר הֵסַ֤בּוּ אֵלַי֙ אֶת־ אֲרוֹן֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לַהֲמִיתֵ֖נִי וְאֶת־ עַמִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·šal·lə·ḥū ’eṯ- ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘eq·rō·wn way·hî kə·ḇō·w ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘eq·rō·wn way·yiz·‘ă·qū hā·‘eq·rō·nîm lê·mōr hê·sab·bū ’ê·lay ’eṯ- ’ă·rō·wn ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl la·hă·mî·ṯê·nî wə·’eṯ- ‘am·mî
verses.literal: So they sent the ark of God to Ekron . . . but as it . . . arrived the Ekronites . . . cried out They have brought us the ark of the God of Israel in order to kill us and our people
verses.literalPt: Enviaram a arca de Deus a Ecrom. Logo que chegou a arca de Deus a Ecrom, clamaram os ecronitas, dizendo: Transportaram para nós a arca do Deus de Israel para nos matar a nós e a todo o nosso povo.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלְח֨וּ וַיַּאַסְפ֜וּ אֶת־ כָּל־ סַרְנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ שַׁלְּח֞וּ אֶת־ אֲר֨וֹן אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְיָשֹׁ֣ב לִמְקֹמ֔וֹ וְלֹֽא־ יָמִ֥ית אֹתִ֖י וְאֶת־ עַמִּ֑י כִּֽי־ הָיְתָ֤ה מְהֽוּמַת־ מָ֙וֶת֙ בְּכָל־ הָעִ֔יר כָּבְדָ֥ה מְאֹ֛ד יַ֥ד הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·lə·ḥū way·ya·’as·p̄ū ’eṯ- kāl- sar·nê p̄ə·liš·tîm way·yō·mə·rū šal·lə·ḥū ’eṯ- ’ă·rō·wn ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl wə·yā·šōḇ lim·qō·mōw wə·lō- yā·mîṯ ’ō·ṯî wə·’eṯ- ‘am·mî kî- hā·yə·ṯāh mə·hū·maṯ- mā·weṯ bə·ḵāl hā·‘îr kā·ḇə·ḏāh mə·’ōḏ yaḏ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm šām
verses.literal: Then the Ekronites called together all the rulers of the Philistines and said Send away the ark of the God of Israel It must return to its place so that it will not kill us and our people For a deadly confusion had pervaded . . . the city the hand of God was very heavy upon it
verses.literalPt: Então, enviaram, e congregaram a todos os régulos dos filisteus, e disseram: Recambiai a arca do Deus de Israel, para que ela volte para o seu lugar e não nos mate a nós e ao nosso povo; pois havia um pânico mortal na cidade toda; a mão de Deus pesava sobremaneira nela.

verses.original: וְהָֽאֲנָשִׁים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ מֵ֔תוּ הֻכּ֖וּ בָּעֳפָלִים וַתַּ֛עַל שַֽׁוְעַ֥ת הָעִ֖יר הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’ă·nā·šîm ’ă·šer lō- mê·ṯū huk·kū bå̄·ʿo·p̄å̄·līm wat·ta·‘al šaw·‘aṯ hā·‘îr haš·šā·mā·yim
verses.literal: Those who did not die were afflicted with tumors and the outcry of the city went up to heaven
verses.literalPt: Os homens que não morriam eram feridos com os tumores; e o clamor da cidade subiu até o céu.
